ex.en: Variable names in C are case sensitive.
ex.zh: C 語言的變數名稱有區分大小寫。

ex.en: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
ex.zh: 在 C 和 C++ 中，變數宣告非常重要。

ex.en: The weather here is highly variable.
ex.zh: 這裡的天氣變化很大。

ex.en: The restaurant's food quality is variable.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的菜品質不太穩定。

ex.en: She would willingly come but she was on vacation.
ex.zh: 她很樂意來，可是她正在休假。

ex.en: When I go on vacation, I'll rent a car.
ex.zh: 我去度假的時候會租一輛車。

ex.en: Where are you going to go on your vacation?
ex.zh: 你放假打算去哪裡玩？

ex.en: They vacationed in France last year.
ex.zh: 他們去年到法國度假。

ex.en: We usually vacation in Hualien every summer.
ex.zh: 我們通常每年夏天都去花蓮度假。

ex.en: There were several rooms still vacant.
ex.zh: 還有幾間空房。

ex.en: Rooms should be left vacant by eleven a.m. on the day of departure.
ex.zh: 退房當天，房間須在上午十一點前清空。

ex.en: Excuse me, is this seat vacant?
ex.zh: 請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

ex.en: The position has been vacant for two months.
ex.zh: 這個職位已經空缺兩個月了。

ex.en: We are looking for someone to fill the vacant post.
ex.zh: 我們正在找人填補這個空缺。

ex.en: He was standing there with a vacant look.
ex.zh: 他站在那裡，一臉茫然。

ex.en: She gave me a vacant stare.
ex.zh: 她茫然地盯著我。

ex.en: The flowers will look more beautiful in the vase.
ex.zh: 把花插在花瓶裡會更好看。

ex.en: I must apologize to you for breaking the vase.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我把你的花瓶打破了。

ex.en: You need to put more water in the vase.
ex.zh: 你需要在花瓶裡多加點水。

vacate.zh: 騰出、搬出、空出（房間、座位、職位）

ex.en: Guests must vacate their rooms by noon.
ex.zh: 房客必須在中午前退房。

ex.en: The tenants vacated the apartment last week.
ex.zh: 房客上週搬出了那間公寓。

ex.en: Please validate your email address to activate your account.
ex.zh: 請驗證你的電子郵件地址以啟用帳號。

ex.en: The data must be validated before the report is published.
ex.zh: 報告發布前必須先驗證資料。

ex.en: The system validates each password automatically.
ex.zh: 系統會自動驗證每組密碼。

ex.en: She made a vanilla chocolate cake for four people.
ex.zh: 她做了一個四人份的香草巧克力蛋糕。

ex.en: I'd like a vanilla ice cream cone.
ex.zh: 我想要一支香草冰淇淋甜筒。

variance.zh: 差異、變動；（預算與實際的）差額

ex.en: There is a large variance between the budget and actual costs.
ex.zh: 預算和實際成本之間有很大的差異。

ex.en: We need to explain any variance in the sales figures.
ex.zh: 我們需要說明銷售數字的任何差異。

ex.en: His story is at variance with the facts.
ex.zh: 他的說法與事實不符。

ex.en: The results were at variance with our predictions.
ex.zh: 結果與我們的預測不一致。

ex.en: The startup reached a valuation of one billion dollars.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司的估值達到十億美元。

ex.en: We need a professional valuation of the property.
ex.zh: 我們需要請專業人員為這處房產估價。

ex.en: Please check the validity of your passport before you travel.
ex.zh: 出國前請確認你的護照是否還在有效期限內。

ex.en: The validity of the contract is two years.
ex.zh: 這份合約的有效期是兩年。

ex.en: You can't deny the validity of everything she did just because of a single mistake.
ex.zh: 你不能只因為一個錯誤，就否定她所做的一切。

ex.en: Some experts question the validity of the survey results.
ex.zh: 有些專家質疑這份調查結果的正確性。

ex.en: There is a lot of variability in the test results.
ex.zh: 測試結果的變異很大。

ex.en: Weather variability makes farming difficult.
ex.zh: 天氣多變讓農業經營很困難。

ex.en: I haven't had the vaccine for Coronavirus.
ex.zh: 我還沒打過新冠病毒疫苗。

ex.en: Scientists are working on a new flu vaccine.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研發新的流感疫苗。

ex.en: She gave us a vague answer.
ex.zh: 她給了我們一個含糊的答案。

ex.en: This paragraph is vague.
ex.zh: 這一段寫得很模糊。

ex.en: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
ex.zh: 她隱約有一種罪惡感。

ex.en: As more paper money came into use, the value fell.
ex.zh: 隨著越來越多紙幣流通，幣值就下跌了。

ex.en: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.
ex.zh: 這個畫框能讓這幅畫增值。

ex.en: Traditional values are relative.
ex.zh: 傳統價值觀是相對的。

ex.en: Our company values include honesty and teamwork.
ex.zh: 我們公司的核心價值包括誠信與團隊合作。

ex.en: She values health above wealth.
ex.zh: 她認為健康比財富更重要。

ex.en: He valued the professor's advice.
ex.zh: 他很重視教授的建議。

ex.en: I know that some people value my work.
ex.zh: 我知道有些人很看重我的工作。

ex.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
ex.zh: 日本從國外進口各種原料。

ex.en: Air is a mixture of various gases.
ex.zh: 空氣是各種氣體的混合物。

ex.en: He had various experiences in his life.
ex.zh: 他一生中有過各種經歷。

ex.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
ex.zh: 菜單上有各式各樣的菜色。

ex.en: This store has a variety of spices.
ex.zh: 這家店有各種香料。

ex.en: We talked about a variety of topics.
ex.zh: 我們聊了各種話題。

ex.en: This is a new variety of apple.
ex.zh: 這是一種新品種的蘋果。

ex.en: Taiwan grows many varieties of tea.
ex.zh: 台灣種植很多品種的茶。

ex.en: The price of gold varies from day to day.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在變動。

ex.en: Availability may vary by region and device compatibility.
ex.zh: 實際提供情況可能因地區和裝置相容性而有所不同。

ex.en: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
ex.zh: 中國幅員遼闊，因此茶的種類各不相同。

ex.en: The Sahara is a vast desert.
ex.zh: 撒哈拉是一片廣大的沙漠。

ex.en: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.
ex.zh: 龐大而精密的系統通常建立在幾條簡單的規則上。

ex.en: The vast majority of users like the new design.
ex.zh: 絕大多數使用者都喜歡新設計。

ex.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
ex.zh: 真正的友誼比金錢更有價值。

ex.en: The computer is undoubtedly a valuable tool.
ex.zh: 電腦無疑是很有用的工具。

ex.en: Nothing is more valuable than good health.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比健康更寶貴。

ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
ex.zh: 你應該把貴重物品放在安全的地方。

ex.en: Please don't leave valuables in your car.
ex.zh: 請勿將貴重物品留在車內。

ex.en: There is little variation in prices between the two stores.
ex.zh: 這兩家店的價格差異不大。

ex.en: Sales show a seasonal variation every year.
ex.zh: 銷售額每年都有季節性的變化。

ex.en: This dish is a variation of a traditional recipe.
ex.zh: 這道菜是傳統食譜的變化版。

ex.en: There are many variations of this game.
ex.zh: 這個遊戲有很多種玩法變化。

ex.en: Tom was the last one to get in the van.
ex.zh: 湯姆是最後一個上廂型車的。

ex.en: A big van appeared on the street corner.
ex.zh: 街角出現了一輛大型廂型車。

ex.en: The delivery van arrived at noon.
ex.zh: 送貨車中午到了。

ex.en: Turn off the main water valve before fixing the pipe.
ex.zh: 修水管前先把總水閥關掉。

ex.en: The technician replaced a broken valve in the machine.
ex.zh: 技師更換了機器裡一個壞掉的閥門。

ex.en: My grandfather had surgery to repair a heart valve.
ex.zh: 我爺爺動了手術修補心臟瓣膜。

ex.en: Valves in the veins keep blood flowing in one direction.
ex.zh: 靜脈裡的瓣膜讓血液往單一方向流動。

ex.en: Scientists are studying a new variant of the virus.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研究這種病毒的新變種。

ex.en: The car comes in three variants.
ex.zh: 這款車有三種車型可選。

ex.en: "Colour" is the British variant of "color."
ex.zh: colour 是 color 的英式拼法。

ex.en: There are several variant spellings of the name.
ex.zh: 這個名字有好幾種不同的拼法。

ex.en: The study compared two variant forms of the gene.
ex.zh: 這項研究比較了該基因的兩種變異型。

ex.en: Have you had your flu vaccination this year?
ex.zh: 你今年打流感疫苗了嗎？

ex.en: Vaccination is free for children under six.
ex.zh: 六歲以下兒童可以免費接種疫苗。

ex.en: Every Tuesday morning the housekeeper vacuums.
ex.zh: 每週二早上，管家都會用吸塵器打掃。

ex.en: The homemaker vacuumed the carpet.
ex.zh: 她用吸塵器清理地毯。

ex.en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
ex.zh: 這台吸塵器是我免費拿到的。

ex.en: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
ex.zh: 我用吸塵器把地上的灰塵吸乾淨。

ex.en: Sound cannot travel in a vacuum.
ex.zh: 聲音無法在真空中傳播。

ex.en: The coffee is sealed in a vacuum pack.
ex.zh: 咖啡用真空包裝密封。

ex.en: A beautiful valley lies behind the hill.
ex.zh: 小山後面有一座美麗的山谷。

ex.en: We went down to the valley where the village is.
ex.zh: 我們下到村莊所在的山谷。

ex.en: They marched northwest into the Shenandoah Valley.
ex.zh: 他們往西北方進軍，進入謝南多亞河谷。

ex.en: The form requires validation before submission.
ex.zh: 表格送出前必須先完成驗證。

ex.en: Data validation prevents many entry errors.
ex.zh: 資料驗證可以避免許多輸入錯誤。

ex.en: Sorry, we have no vacancies tonight.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我們今晚沒有空房。

ex.en: The sign outside the motel said "Vacancy."
ex.zh: 汽車旅館外面的招牌寫著「有空房」。

ex.en: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
ex.zh: 業務部有一個職缺。

ex.en: We advertised the vacancy online last week.
ex.zh: 我們上週在網路上刊登了這個職缺。

ex.en: We gave our car keys to the valet.
ex.zh: 我們把車鑰匙交給代客停車的人員。

ex.en: Valet parking costs 20 dollars a night.
ex.zh: 代客停車一晚 20 美元。

ex.en: This passport is valid for five years.
ex.zh: 這本護照的有效期是五年。

ex.en: This ticket is valid for three days.
ex.zh: 這張票三天內有效。

ex.en: The special conditions will be valid until 2025.
ex.zh: 此特殊條件有效期限至 2025 年。

ex.en: That's a valid point.
ex.zh: 你說得很有道理。

ex.en: She had a valid reason for being late.
ex.zh: 她遲到有正當的理由。
